storyNotes.title: London, England
storyNotes.subtitle: An invitation, a pursuit, and a new allegiance. Time passed: 0 → 2.

notes.title: Story
notes.text: Since the winter of 1924, people and objects have vanished from Arkham—and even from memory. Similar reports around the world lead the investigators into an international mystery. After accepting Inspector Li Flint’s offer, the group follows the trail through Boston to London and encounters the Red-Gloved Man.

notes.title: Choices
items: William Yorick went alone to the meeting, as requested.
The investigators accepted Flint’s offer and agreed to report their findings to him.

notes.title: Consequences
items: Resolution 2. All three investigators survived.
Victory display: 6. Akachi, Norman, and Yorick each earned 6 XP; no physical or mental trauma. The purchased upgrades are recorded below.
William Yorick became the bearer of The Eye of Ravens.
Campaign note: You haven’t seen the last of the Red-Gloved Man.
Time: +1 before the scenario and +1 after its resolution; total 2.
Chaos bag: remove 1 elder thing token; add 1 tablet token.

notes.title: Story
notes.text: Commissioner Taylor questions the investigators. Flint introduces the Foundation and its work against the Coterie. The investigators become an independent cell and receive leads across the world.

notes.title: Choices
items: The cell did not tell Taylor about the disappearances.
The investigators embarked from London.

notes.title: Consequences
items: Campaign note: The cell hid the truth from Taylor.
Chaos bag: remove 1 tablet token; add 1 elder thing token.
Time passed remains 2. No additional XP award is recorded.

notes.title: Leads received
items: Shanghai: a woman with a red parasol and a secret cabal. Alexandria: beastly killings. Buenos Aires: high-profile burglaries and a possible key.
Nairobi: a sanctum. Anchorage: a prospector’s journal. Constantinople: a possible defector.
Kathmandu: a spirit resembling an operative. Marrakesh: a dangerous operative, tomb robberies, and overgrowth. Havana: smuggling.

metaItems: Session: 2 · Carnevale of Horrors → Dealings in the Dark → Alexandria

storyNotes.title: Venice, Italy
storyNotes.subtitle: The Carnevale ends in devastation. Time passed: 3 → 6.

notes.title: Story
notes.text: A masked killer’s trail leads the investigators to Venice during the Carnevale. They wake battered and drenched aboard a gondola; wrecked boats fill the canals and blood stains the streets. Many were sacrificed to Cnidathqua during the Carnevale.

notes.title: Consequences
items: No resolution was reached. Victory display: 5; each investigator earned 5 XP.
William Yorick and Norman Withers each suffered 1 physical trauma. Akachi Onyele suffered 1 mental trauma.
After the required reveler transfer, one or two Innocent Revelers remained beneath the act deck; no further rewards were granted.
The side story cost 3 time instead of entry XP: time passed 3 → 6. The cell then embarked for Istanbul.

notes.title: Story awards
items: William Yorick received Bauta; Norman Withers received Pantalone; Akachi Onyele received Medico Della Peste.
Each mask is a free story award and does not count toward its investigator’s deck size. The cards are recorded in the existing Carnevale upgrade window below.

storyNotes.title: Venice → Istanbul
storyNotes.text: Travel · time passed 6 → 7 (+1). Status Report Alpha is reached on arrival.

storyNotes.title: Istanbul, Turkey
storyNotes.subtitle: A false promise, a sealed talisman, and a broken alliance. Time passed: 7 → 10.

notes.title: Report
notes.text: The Foundation receives more reports of disappearances as the cell’s journey continues.

notes.title: Chaos bag
items: Add 1 cultist token to the chaos bag.

notes.title: Story
notes.text: The cell meets museum curator Ece Şahin, reveals the Eye of Ravens, and learns of a talisman sought by a murderous cult. Ece helps them recover it, but the investigators never intend to honor their promise to entrust it to her. After escaping the city, they seal the talisman and end the unnatural eclipse. Their refusal to surrender it leaves Ece angry and distrustful.

notes.title: Choices
items: The cell promised to find the talisman and place it in Ece’s care, while secretly intending to keep it. Campaign note: The cell is deceiving Ece.
Chaos bag, before the scenario: remove 1 tablet token and add 1 elder thing token. No substitute XP was awarded.
Ece accompanied the cell during this scenario. She was not awarded as a permanent deck card.

notes.title: Consequences
items: Resolution 1 continued through Resolution 3 to Resolution 5. All three investigators survived.
Victory display: 5; each investigator earned 5 XP. No additional trauma was recorded; the Carnevale trauma remains.
Norman Withers became the bearer of The Twisted Antiprism.
Campaign note: Ece does not trust the cell.
Mark 3 time: 7 → 10, triggering Status Report Epsilon.

notes.title: Report
notes.text: The investigators realize they are being followed. For the rest of the campaign, scenario setup adds one random Red Coterie enemy matching a “haven’t seen the last of” campaign record. The current matching record names the Red-Gloved Man.

items: You haven’t seen the last of the Red-Gloved Man.
The cell hid the truth from Taylor.
Many were sacrificed to Cnidathqua during the Carnevale.
The cell is deceiving Ece.
Ece does not trust the cell.

notes.title: Journey
items: London → Venice → Istanbul. Time passed at the end of Dealings in the Dark: 10.
Time: prologue 2 + London–Venice travel 1 + Carnevale entry 3 + Venice–Istanbul travel 1 + Dealings in the Dark 3.
Status Report Alpha resolved at time 7; Status Report Epsilon resolved at time 10.
Next destination: Alexandria. Current recorded time is 11, compared with 10 at the end of Istanbul. Dogs of War was selected in advance; its story and scenario have not started.

notes.text: Recovered in Riddles and Rain. The Eye of Ravens is carried as a campaign key; it is not a purchased deck upgrade. Expand to view the stable side.
Recovered in Dealings in the Dark. A campaign key carried by Norman, not a purchased deck upgrade. Expand to view the stable side.

items: Riddles and Rain: −1 elder thing token, +1 tablet token.
The Foundation: −1 tablet token, +1 elder thing token.
The two London swaps canceled out; there was no net change before leaving London.
Status Report Alpha: +1 cultist token.
Dealings in the Dark, deceiving Ece: remove 1 tablet token and add 1 elder thing token, as recorded in the scenario results.

notes.title: Carnevale rewards
items: William Yorick: Bauta; 1 physical trauma, 0 mental trauma.
Norman Withers: Pantalone; 1 physical trauma, 0 mental trauma.
Akachi Onyele: Medico Della Peste; 0 physical trauma, 1 mental trauma.
The three masks cost no XP and do not count toward deck size. Each investigator earned 5 XP in Carnevale and 5 XP in Dealings in the Dark.

notes.title: Status Report Epsilon
items: At future scenario setup, add one random Red Coterie enemy whose name matches a “haven’t seen the last of” record. Current match: the Red-Gloved Man.
